_note: Hand-authored fixture (edit directly, then `pnpm --filter @oybc/shared run gen:sync-fixtures`). Pins packages/shared/src/algorithms/countsToward.ts (tests/algorithms/countsToward.test.ts) against its Swift twin Helpers/CountsToward.swift (OYBCTests/CountsTowardVectorTests.swift) — docs/SHARED_COUNTER_SETTINGS.md §3 (D10: one credit per completion occurrence; D11: count from `countsTowardSince`). Task defaults for unlisted fields: type=normal, isCompleted=false, isDeleted=false, createdAt=2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z. Event defaults: isDeleted=false, kind=increment when delta is set else completion. Board defaults: status=active, isDeleted=false. Placement defaults: isDeleted=false. Link defaults: isDeleted=false. `state` vectors take an optional `window` ({windowStart, windowEnd}; absent = lifetime). `credits` / `candidates` / `planSet` name occurrences ({kind: event|childEvent|board|lifetime}); the test derives each credit id with countsTowardEventId(lineageRootId(contributor), occurrence) and compares sets sorted by id. `planSet.lineageWanted` lists occurrences other lineage members keep.
